contract.scope: Owner-only local IPC. No shared snapshots, events, exports, shell import or production Agent admission.
contract.detection: Read only the daemon process environment. Not login-shell or OS settings detection.
contract.mutation: D20: all daemon variables inherit except CAFE_SPACE_*. Owner overrides win; proxy overrides replace both Unix spellings. adopt_detected pins a value by name; remove restores inheritance; set accepts any valid non-reserved variable name. All writes affect future children only; unknown is never replayed.
contract.privacy: Proxy display contains only validated scheme/host/port and optional constant credential mask; every other variable displays only set. Detected lists PATH/proxy/CA/SSH/NODE_OPTIONS and *_API_KEY/*_TOKEN only. At most 256 entries per list; unrepresentable names are omitted from status only, not inheritance. Non-UTF8/invalid values are not pinnable (adoptable=false), but still inherit. No raw values in Debug, responses or events.
contract.tools: Absolute effective PATH only, at most 256 directories. git/node/npm plus pwsh on Windows. Inspect files only, never execute tools, import shells, search cwd or return paths. A found file is not a version/launch guarantee.

error.message: Outcome unknown; read state without retrying.
